confirm.title: PlayGuard console found
confirm.description: Add **{name}** (console id `{console_id}`)? Its own Home Assistant device (MQTT discovery) is replaced by this integration's, with the same entities, game names, the week's play time and long-term statistics.

user.title: Add a PlayGuard console
user.description: The consoles whose state is on the broker and not set up yet. Pick one, or another console to add it by its id.

data_description.console: Its name and id, and its topic prefix when it is not playguard.

manual.title: Add a PlayGuard console by its id
manual.description: Its id is in PlayGuard › Console › Remote access › Console id. The integration then waits up to 10 seconds for the console's state on the broker.

reconfigure.title: Change the topic prefix
reconfigure.description: The prefix {name} publishes under: `topic_prefix` in PlayGuard's sync.conf.

error.invalid_console_id: A console id is 8 characters, 0 to 9 and a to f.
error.invalid_prefix: This prefix cannot be part of an MQTT topic.
error.no_state: This console has published nothing on the broker under this prefix. Check the console id and the prefix, and that the console's link is up once (PlayGuard › Console › Remote access › Status).

abort.already_configured: This console is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: This message is not a PlayGuard state.
abort.mqtt_not_ready: The MQTT integration is not set up yet: PlayGuard talks to Home Assistant through it. Set it up first, on the same broker as the console.

data.take_over_discovery: Replace the console's own Home Assistant device
data.keep_values_asleep: Keep the last values while the console sleeps

data_description.take_over_discovery: Turns the console's MQTT discovery off, so its entities are not there twice. Off: the console publishes its own device again.
data_description.keep_values_asleep: While the console is off the broker (asleep, off, out of reach), its entities keep showing what it last said, and a change made to a control waits for it on the broker. Off: every entity but Online is unavailable then.
data_description.notify_refused: An order sent while the console sleeps, or one waiting for PlayGuard's confirmation, gets its answer after its action returned: a refusal then raises a notification, which the next order applied takes away. A refusal while the action waits for the answer (up to 10 seconds) makes the action fail, saying why, whatever this option.

mqtt_not_ready.message: The MQTT integration is not available yet.

read_only.message: PlayGuard is in read-only mode on this console: it changes nothing.

policy_off.message: The console refuses orders (Remote access › Orders received).

timer_writes_disabled.message: Orders may not change the play timer: turn on Remote access › Orders may change the play timer on the console.

read_only_entity.message: This value cannot be changed from here.

no_such_profile.message: No profile named {profile} is saved in PlayGuard.

reason_policy_off.message: orders are refused (Remote access › Orders received)

reason_timer_writes_disabled.message: changing the play timer remotely is off (Remote access › Orders may change the play timer)

reason_not_confirmed.message: not confirmed on the console, or the PIN was not entered

reason_gated.message: the play timer is counting down and could not be unlocked

reason_unlock_failed.message: parental controls could not be unlocked

reason_not_custom.message: only with the custom restriction level

reason_busy.message: PlayGuard could not do it now, try again

logbook_play_blocked_limit.message: blocked the games: the day's limit is reached

newer_schema.title: {name} speaks a newer PlayGuard protocol
newer_schema.description: {name} publishes schema {schema}; this integration knows schema {known}. Update the PlayGuard integration: some values may be missing until then.

native_discovery.title: {name} publishes its own Home Assistant device again

confirm.title: {name}'s entities are there twice
confirm.description:
The console's own MQTT device is back next to this integration's: it was turned on again in PlayGuard, or the console's PlayGuard is too old to take the order that turns it off. Submit to ask the console again to turn it off.

If it comes back, update PlayGuard, or turn off *Create the device in Home Assistant (MQTT discovery)* in PlayGuard › Console › Remote access. To keep the console's own device instead, turn off this integration's option *Replace the console's own Home Assistant device*.

agent_version.title: {name} runs an older PlayGuard agent
agent_version.description: PlayGuard {app} is installed on {name}, but its agent, which works while PlayGuard is closed, is still {agent}: its update was put off. Update it in PlayGuard › Console › Optional modules › Link agent (PlayGuard also offers it when it starts).

refused_policy_off.title: {name} refuses Home Assistant's orders
refused_policy_off.description: {name} is set to refuse the orders it receives, so what is changed here is not carried out. On the console, in PlayGuard › Console › Remote access › Orders received, pick Carry them out at once or Ask on the console. This goes away once the console says so.

refused_timer_writes_disabled.title: {name} does not let orders change the play timer
refused_timer_writes_disabled.description: Limits, extra time, profiles, No more play today and unlocking parental controls need it. On the console, turn on PlayGuard › Console › Remote access › Orders may change the play timer. This goes away once the console says so.

refused_read_only.title: PlayGuard is read-only on {name}
refused_read_only.description: PlayGuard opens read-only on a firmware it does not support yet, and refuses every order. Update PlayGuard on the console (it offers it when it checks for updates). This goes away once the console says so.

taken_over.title: PlayGuard is now Boréale for Nintendo Switch
taken_over.description: Your consoles moved from the integration {legacy} to Boréale, with their entities, their history and their statistics. Automations, scripts and blueprints that use its actions, triggers and conditions ({legacy}.add_bonus_time, {legacy}.game_started, {legacy}.is_playing…) must now use boreale.… instead: the old names no longer answer. Ignore this once done.

taken_over_installed.title: PlayGuard is now Boréale for Nintendo Switch
taken_over_installed.description:
Your consoles moved from the integration {legacy} to Boréale, with their entities, their history and their statistics. Automations, scripts and blueprints that use its actions, triggers and conditions ({legacy}.add_bonus_time, {legacy}.game_started, {legacy}.is_playing…) must now use boreale.… instead: the old names no longer answer. Ignore this once done.

The old integration is still installed: remove PlayGuard in HACS, or delete the folder custom_components/{legacy}, then restart Home Assistant.

set_limits.name: Set the limits
set_limits.description: Sets a day's limit, every day's, today's, or the whole week's (1440 = no limit).

week.name: Week
week.description: Seven limits, Sunday first, in place of minutes and day.

add_bonus_time.name: Add extra time
add_bonus_time.description: Extra minutes today; the usual limit comes back tomorrow.

apply_profile.name: Apply a profile
apply_profile.description: Applies the limits of a profile saved in PlayGuard.

stop_today.name: No more play today
stop_today.description: 0 minutes today; the usual limit comes back tomorrow.

lock_now.name: Turn parental controls back on
lock_now.description: Turns parental controls back on after a temporary unlock.

request_report.name: Request a diagnostic report
request_report.description: The console saves a report on its SD card, and publishes it when Remote access allows it (then in the device's diagnostics).

get_play_time.name: Get the play time
get_play_time.description: Returns today's play time (each game's, each account's, the game played, the limit and what is left of it, bedtime) or the last seven days'.

period.name: Period
period.description: Today, or the last seven days.

game_started.name: Game started
game_started.description: Triggers when a game starts on the console.

game_stopped.name: Game stopped
game_stopped.description: Triggers when the game stops: closed, suspended, or another one started.

time_running_out.name: Time running out
time_running_out.description: Triggers when 10 minutes or fewer are left of today's limit while a game is played.

games_blocked.name: Games blocked
games_blocked.description: Triggers when games are blocked: by the day's limit (or No more play today), or by bedtime.

order_refused.name: Order refused
order_refused.description: Triggers when the console refuses an order.

is_playing.name: A game is played
is_playing.description: Tests if a game is played on the console.

limit_reached.name: Limit reached
limit_reached.description: Tests if today's limit is reached on the console.

parental_controls_on.name: Parental controls on
parental_controls_on.description: Tests if the console's parental controls are on (not unlocked for now).
